# 2 bedroom terraced house for sale

> Nestled in the charming Grove Terrace of Canterbury, this delightful mid-terrace house, built in 1870, offers a perfect blend of period character and modern comfort. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a spacious sitting room, featuring a striking fireplace that serves as a focal point for the room.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bedrooms
- Plocha: 76 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: Grove Terrace, Canterbury
- Cena: £325,000
